name: Mirai Sekai no Planeta
original_name: ミライセカイのプラネッタ
source:
In the near future, technology has progressed to a point where people can live both in reality and the internet world, Planeta. Satoru came to Planeta to enjoy a school life in the virtual world. But he was recruited to work for the detective team Sprites after meeting their leader Ayaka. At the same time, there was a terrorist attack in Planeta, caused by a hacker who went by Irurihito.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/03/01/march-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
近未来，科技已经进步到人们可以同时在现实和网络世界“Planeta”中生活。悟来到Planeta享受虚拟世界中的校园生活。但在遇到了侦探团队“Sprites”的首领彩华后，他被招募加入了团队。与此同时，Planeta中发生了一起由黑客“入仁人”策划的恐怖袭击。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/03/01/march-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
